meaning.why_this_file_matters: Rahu is a strong provenance test because the same name spans 2024 literary/social material, a March 2026 dream-growth story and a May 2026 documentary social conversation.
known: Rahu appears repeatedly in late-2024 Chronicle social scenes.
The 1 March 2026 conversation story explicitly frames Rahu as a lost soul / Mud Dweller with 1/137 growth.
Rahu reappears as a social interlocutor on 25 May 2026.
interpretive: A recurring theme of pressure toward growth links the layers, but that continuity is interpretive rather than proof of one stable character-role.
Tomato-villain and Mud-Dweller states are scene-bound.
unknown: Exact continuity between literary, dream and documentary Rahu layers remains unresolved.
Closer source material for the May 2026 discussion is still desirable.
